thought.text: Keycloak is fully configured and verified. Now let me start a SQL Server (LocalDB is Windows-only; the backend uses the SqlServer EF provider). Meanwhile, check npm progress.

reasoning_content:
Roles are in the token (editor, app-access on the strassennamen client). Keycloak is fully configured:
- Realm: my-realm
- Client: strassennamen (public, standard flow, direct access grants, implicit flow enabled; no client authentication)
- Client roles: app-access, editor
- Redirect URIs: http://localhost:4200/*, http://localhost:5000/*
- Web Origins: http://localhost:4200/*
- Root URL / Admin URL / post-logout: http://localhost:4200/*
- Test user user1/user1pass with both roles

Next, I need a SQL Server for EF Core (only Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer + FluentMigrator.Runner.SqlServer are referenced). LocalDB is Windows-only, so I'll use the mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest image in Docker.

Next, the frontend: check the progress of npm i.
